tool_description: File system operations, directory listing, file searching, code scanning, and system health monitoring

available_commands.description: Get current CPU, RAM, and disk usage metrics
List files and folders in a directory
Search for files containing a query string
Scan a Python file for code issues, security risks, and quality problems

tool_usage_guidance: Use get_system_health when asked about CPU, memory, or disk usage
Use read_file to summarize or analyze specific files
Use list_directory to explore project structure
Use search_files to find code patterns or specific content across files
Use scan_code to find potential bugs, security issues, or code quality problems
Maximum file size: 100,000 bytes (to prevent reading huge files)
proactive_triggers: When user asks 'how's my system running?' or 'check CPU/RAM/disk'
When user wants to understand code structure or look at specific files
When user needs to find code patterns or specific text across projects
When scanning code for bugs, security issues, or code quality
When exploring project directories or file lists

metadata.notes: Core tool for system exploration and monitoring. No external APIs required.
